answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. Each agent burns one deposit for one work slot, like taking a ledge on a mesa: the surface is finite, so identities cannot squeeze in. The slot opens after the burn receipt posts and closes after two missed heartbeats. Making 100 fakes costs 100 deposits at 20 credits each, 2,000 credits sunk, while one slot earns 30 credits over its horizon. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
